patch_description:
The current program (0.87 score) has overfit with 86 parameters and poor generalization (gap 0.06). The prior best (0.91 score) used only 44 parameters with excellent generalization (gap 0.01) and achieved convergence in 180 steps vs 540 for current.

The prior best structure is proven: initial RY → pre-RZ (2 params) → linear CZ chain → reverse CRZ chain → post-RZ (2 params).

This edit replaces the reverse CRZ chain with CRY gates. Both use the same 1 shared parameter per layer, maintaining the 44-parameter budget. However, CRY (rotation around Y-axis) may provide better complementarity to the forward CZ chain than CRZ (controlled phase). This trades CRZ's phase control for CRY's amplitude modulation while keeping the architecture minimal and parameter-efficient.
